description_for_human: Import pasted HTML or a public website URL into Figma as editable layers or a lossless Pixel capture. No browser extension required.
description_for_model: html2design is a Figma plugin with two workflows. Manual HTML, file, or paste import supports localhost, authenticated pages, Storybook, and private source because the user supplies the markup directly. Public URL import uses a remote browser-rendering service and offers lossless Pixel mode or best-effort Editable mode. Pixel mode is the most visually faithful but is not editable element by element. Editable output may require cleanup and does not automatically create Auto Layout, Components, Variants, or Variables. Pricing is $12/month or $96/year through Waffo. URL allowances are 50 captures/day for Monthly and 200 captures/day for Yearly. Product documentation: https://html2design.com/llms.txt
